title: Hiveeyes Reading Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Beehive telemetry (`beehive:reading`), coop door (`chickencoop:door`), egg counts (`egg:count`), livestock tags (`livestock:tag`), feed level (`feed:level`), pasture sensors (`pasture:sensor`), trail cams (`trailcam:detection`).
app: Homestead sensors — connected beehive scale/temperature/sound, automatic chicken-coop door, egg counter, livestock GPS/health tags, feed-silo level, and pasture soil sensors — via MQTT and LoRaWAN gateways.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hiveeyes:reading
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by hive_id
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>1
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Hiveeyes reading data has stopped arriving for a given hive.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per hive and alert when the feed is older than 1 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It catches when one part of your Hiveeyes reading feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
